name: Ethereum Classic
classificationNote: Upstream label "Bridge & Cross-Chain / Forged Proof" on a base-layer chain: reclassified as a 51%/consensus attack.
rootCause: On August 6, 2020, Ethereum Classic suffered a second major 51% attack that resulted in a reorganization of 4,236 blocks and an estimated loss of $1.68 million (238,306 ETC) through successful double-spends. This exploit was enabled by rented hashpower, not a contract vulnerability. The attacker controlled a majority of network hashpower and reorganized the chain to double-spend funds, exploiting Ethereum Classic's low Proof-of-Work security and absence of external checkpointing. No smart contract was directly vulnerable.
